record.question: The term 'Kessler Syndrome' refers to a situation in which:
options: intense solar activity disrupts satellite communication systems
Failure of Earth's magnetic field results in increased solar radiation exposure on satellites
Excessive launch of rockets causes depletion of atmospheric oxygen in upper layers
orbital debris accumulation triggers cascading satellite collisions
